bullets.text: Meta Pauses Ray-Ban Glasses - **Meta** halts international sales of Ray-Ban Display glasses due to overwhelming demand and limited supply.
Pioneer’s CarPlay Breakthrough - **Pioneer** introduces the world's first aftermarket spatial audio receiver for existing cars.
Philips Hue’s Smart Lighting - **Philips Hue** launches SpatialAware to optimize color distribution based on room layout.
Intel’s Handheld Gaming CPU - **Intel** develops custom Panther Lake CPUs for a new handheld gaming platform.
AI's Rapid Transformation - **McKinsey** and **General Catalyst** discuss how AI is reshaping investment strategies and workforce dynamics.
Lenovo’s Cross-Device AI - **Lenovo** unveils Qira, an AI assistant designed to operate across its devices.
Mobileye Acquires Robotics Startup - **Mobileye** acquires Mentee Robotics for $900 million, expanding into humanoid robotics.
CES 2026 Highlights - **CES 2026** showcases groundbreaking tech, from AI innovations to quirky gadgets.
Fusion Power Progress - **Commonwealth Fusion Systems** installs first magnet in its Sparc fusion reactor, aiming for clean energy.
AI Chatbot Regulation Proposal - California proposes a four-year ban on AI chatbots in children's toys for safety.
